name: Oceanid Queen

spells.name: Control Water
spells.text:
Area 50 feet long by 50 feet wide

---
By imposing your will upon the water, you can raise or lower the level of water in the chosen area by 10 feet. Creatures that have the water trait and that are in the area when you Cast the Spell must attempt a Fortitude save, with the effects of the Slow spell.

spells.name: Hydraulic Torrent
spells.text:
A swirling torrent of water manifests along a straight line, battering creatures and unattended objects in its path and possibly pushing them away from you. The torrent deals 8d6 bludgeoning damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a basic Fortitude save; unattended objects automatically fail. Creatures and objects that fail are also knocked back 5 feet (10 feet on a critical failure).

---

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Crashing Wave
spells.text:
You summon a crashing wave that sweeps away from you. You deal 6d6 bludgeoning damage to creatures in the area. The water also extinguishes non-magical fires in the area.

---

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Animal Messenger (Sea Life only)
spells.text:
You offer food, and an ordinary Tiny animal within range approaches to eat it. You imprint the image, direction, and distance of an obvious place or landmark well known to you within the animal. You can also attach a small object or note up to light Bulk to it. The animal does its best to reach the destination; if it makes it there, it waits nearby and allows nonhostile creatures to approach and remove the attached object. The spell ends after the message is delivered or after 24 hours, whichever comes first.

If there are no Tiny wild animals in range, the spell is lost.

spells.name: Mist
spells.text: You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become Concealed, and all creatures outside the mist become concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.

spells.name: Water Breathing
spells.text:
The targets can breathe underwater.

---

Heightened (3rd) The duration increases to 8 hours.

Heightened (4th) The duration increases to until your next daily preparations.

spells.name: Hydraulic Push
spells.text:
You call forth a powerful blast of pressurized water that bludgeons the target and knocks it back. Make a ranged spell attack roll.

---

Critical Success The target takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked back 10 feet.

Success The target takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage and is knocked back 5 feet.

---

Heightened (+1) The bludgeoning damage increases by 2d6.

items.name: Animal Empathy
items.text: An oceanid queen can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals, and gets a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to influence sea life.

items.name: Tied to the Sea
items.text: An oceanid queen is intrinsically tied to a dominion of the sea, which may include some solid boundaries around or above the surface, such as shorelines, islands, or coral reefs, but is more prominently defined by currents and weather patterns. This otherwise acts as Tied to the Land.

items.name: (Nymph Queen) Nymph's Beauty
items.text: 30 feet. Creatures that start their turn in the emanation must succeed at a DC 35 Will save save or become Slowed 1 and Dazzled for 1 round.

items.name: Waveshaper
items.text:
Frequency once per hour

---
Effect The oceanid takes 1 minute to create waves and currents to double or halve the speed of creatures, objects, or vehicles traveling along the surface of the water within 1,000 feet, affecting up to 100 contiguous 5-foot squares in a shapable area (typically enough to affect 1 galley, 2 longships, or 3 cutters). This ability requires a line of sight to some part of the area and can be Sustained for up to 1 hour. An unwilling creature can resist the effect by succeeding at a DC 35 Fortitude save save, which must be repeated once per minute for as long as it remains within the affected area.

items.name: (Nymph Queen) Change Shape
items.text:
Nymph queens can transform between their original form, which looks much like a typical nymph of their kind, and any Small or Medium humanoid form, typically choosing a more humanoid-looking version of their natural form.

---

items.name: (Nymph Queen) Focus Beauty
items.text:
Requirements The target creature is affected by the oceanid queen's nymph's beauty aura

---
Effect The required creature is Blinded for 1 hour and is blown 120 feet away from the queen by a punctuating wave of water.

items.name: (Nymph Queen) Inspiration
items.text:
The nymph queen inspires a single intelligent creature by giving that creature a token of her favor, typically a lock of her hair, though it can be some other significant object as well. As long as the creature carries her token and remains in good standing with her, the creature gains a +1 status bonus to all Crafting checks, Performance checks, and Will saves.

If the nymph grants her token to a bard, and she's the bard's muse, the queen chooses one additional benefit granted by her token: a +1 status bonus to all Lore checks, a +2 status bonus to Performance checks when determining the effects of compositions, a +4 status bonus to untrained skill checks, or a +2 status bonus to Will saves against fey.

Effect: Nymph Queen's Inspiration

items.name: Ocean's Grasp
items.text:
Effect Water surrounds one creature within 60 feet. The target must attempt a DC 38 Fortitude save save.

---
Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes 3d10 bludgeoning damage and becomes Immobilized for 1 round or until it Escapes.

Failure As success, but 6d10 bludgeoning damage and immobilized for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As success, but 9d10 bludgeoning damage and Restrained for 1 minute.

text:
While one oceanid queen may rule over an entire inland sea, the majority define their territories in the vast, wide-open ocean by the flow of currents, the edges of continental shelves, and the curves of recurring weather patterns. As such, the boundaries between oceanid queendoms are both literally and figuratively fluid, making them difficult for land-born creatures to comprehend. Wise sailors know to avoid offending any oceanid queen, as those who do are forced to retire lest they accidentally stumble into the domain of the ruler they insulted, who will not hesitate to capsize entire fleets in revenge.

---
Where naiads are bound to their freshwater springs and nereids walk as they will between wave and shore, oceanid nymphs are, to their cores, creatures of the seas. They ride the open waves as naturally as dolphins and live among the deepest depths without care for cold, darkness, or pressure. As such, they're a rare and mysterious sight for those mortals who dwell on land but well-known to denizens of the sea, such as merfolk, for whom they're often confused.

Oceanids can be as tempestuous as their watery home, with moods that change on a whim. They're quick to love and even quicker to anger. At heart, however, they're nurturing guardians, especially to the young, the elderly, the injured, and the desperate. It's not unheard of for oceanids to take in and raise children who've been abandoned near the shore, and sailors who speak of them with respect often miraculously survive storms and sinkings that otherwise leave no survivors.
